_analysis_notes.summary: The project repository currently lacks a root-level .gitignore file, causing dependencies (node_modules, .venv), build artifacts (dist, __pycache__), and environment variables (.env) to appear as untracked files. This plan outlines the creation of a comprehensive .gitignore to ensure repository cleanliness and security.
_analysis_notes.impact_description: Initializes a global ignore policy covering both Angular (Front_end) and Python/FastAPI (Back_end) environments.
risks: Potential loss of .env configuration if not backed up elsewhere (remedied by standard ignore practices)

steps.title: Create Root .gitignore with Multi-Stack Patterns
steps.description: Create a file named '.gitignore' in the project root folder. Add the following patterns: # Node/Angular (node_modules, .angular, dist, *.log), # Python (__pycache__, .venv, env, .env, *.pyc, *.pyo, *.pyd, .db, .sqlite3), # IDE/OS (.vscode, .idea, .DS_Store, Thumbs.db).
steps.validation: Check if 'e:/Job Recommendation/Project/.gitignore' exists and contains the specified patterns.

steps.title: Verify Repository State
steps.description: Execute 'git status' and confirm that node_modules, .angular, and Python cache directories are no longer listed as untracked files.
steps.validation: Git status output reflects only intentional source files and configuration.
